proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ A B C hABC h1 h2
  have hAC : dist A B = dist A C := by
    refine EuclideanGeometry.dist_eq_of_angle_eq_angle_of_angle_ne_pi
      (by rw [h1, EuclideanGeometry.angle_comm]) ?_
    exact (EuclideanGeometry.angle_lt_pi_of_not_collinear (by rwa [Set.insert_comm])).ne
  have hBA : dist B C = dist B A := by
    refine EuclideanGeometry.dist_eq_of_angle_eq_angle_of_angle_ne_pi
      (by rw [h2, EuclideanGeometry.angle_comm]) ?_
    rw [EuclideanGeometry.angle_comm]
    exact (EuclideanGeometry.angle_lt_pi_of_not_collinear hABC).ne
  constructor
  · rw [hBA, dist_comm]
  · rw [hBA, dist_comm B A, hAC, dist_comm]
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] (A B C : P), ¬Collinear ℝ ({A, B, C} : Set P) → EuclideanGeometry.angle A B C = EuclideanGeometry.angle B C A → EuclideanGeometry.angle B C A = EuclideanGeometry.angle C A B → dist A B = dist B C ∧ dist B C = dist C A
